shortDescription: Set network interface parameters in WTI OOB and PDU devices

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: interface
options.description: This is the ethernet port name that is getting configured.

options.name: ipv4address
options.description: IPv4 format IP address for the defined interface Port.

options.name: ipv4dhcpdefgateway
options.description: Enable or Disable this ports configuration as the default IPv4 route for the device.

options.name: ipv4dhcpenable
options.description: Enable IPv4 DHCP request call to obtain confufuration information.

options.name: ipv4dhcphostname
options.description: Define IPv4 DHCP Hostname.

options.name: ipv4dhcplease
options.description: IPv4 DHCP Lease Time.

options.name: ipv4dhcpobdns
options.description: IPv6 DHCP Obtain DNS addresses auto.

options.name: ipv4dhcpupdns
options.description: IPv4 DHCP DNS Server Update.

options.name: ipv4gateway
options.description: IPv4 format Gateway address for the defined interface Port.

options.name: ipv4netmask
options.description: IPv4 format Netmask for the defined interface Port.

options.name: ipv6address
options.description: IPv6 format IP address for the defined interface Port.

options.name: ipv6gateway
options.description: IPv6 format Gateway address for the defined interface Port.

options.name: ipv6subnetprefix
options.description: IPv6 format Subnet Prefix for the defined interface Port.

options.name: negotiation
options.description: This is the speed of the interface port being configured. 0=Auto, 1=10/half, 2=10/full, 3=100/half, 4=100/full, 5=1000/half, 6=1000/full

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
